name: Jotform Sign
description:
Create, share, and edit e-sign documents right inside Claude with Jotform Sign.

Generate agreements, forms, and other signable documents from simple prompts, then customize fields, recipients, signing order, and workflows through conversation. Send documents for signature and streamline approvals with legally binding e-signatures that work on any device.

Perfect for creating contracts, onboarding paperwork, consent forms, and other documents that require signatures — without starting from scratch.

Key Features

Generate signable documents from natural language prompts
Create contracts, agreements, forms, and approval documents in minutes
Add signature fields, dates, initials, and other fillable fields
Configure recipients, signing order, and approval workflows
Send documents for secure, legally binding e-signatures
Track document status and manage signed documents in one place
Sign and complete documents from any device

Create e-sign documents for all use cases, including:

Employment contracts and onboarding documents
Client agreements and service contracts
NDAs and confidentiality agreements
Consent and waiver forms
Sales proposals and approval workflows
Vendor and partnership agreements
Rental and lease agreements
Internal approvals, policies, and acknowledgments

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jotform Sign to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jotform Sign to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.jotform.com/mcp-sign-v1. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jotform Sign MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jotform Sign provides these MCP tools: create_sign_document, display_sign_document, edit_sign_document, update_sign_document_content, get_signers, update_signer, get_signing_status, send_for_signature, list_submissions, mcp_app_request, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jotform Sign?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jotform Sign in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Jotform Sign MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jotform Sign requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Jotform Sign is developed by Jotform. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
